ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The beige folder holds the ear chart. ... The brown folder holds the spine chart. ... The pink folder holds the bladder chart. ... What colour is the folder with the chart on the body part that stores urine?" -> answer org pink; the alt prompt asks about the ear (bridge alt), its 11th statement. Possible answers after the patch: beige (answer of bridge alt's statement), brown (answer at the same statement slot), green (the alt prompt's own answer), pink (answer org kept).
